Rendezvous with the fleet.|Vice Admiral Rampart and the clone trooper|}} During the early [[Imperial Era]], a '''clone trooper''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[stormtrooper]] and [[technician]].Per the audio description for "[[Kamino Lost]]" available on [[Disney+]]. ==Biography== In [[19 BBY]], this clone stormtrooper was stationed aboard a [[VZ-114|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was apart of an Imperial [[fleet]] sent to [[Kamino]] to destroy the planet's [[cloning]] facilities. The Venator that the clone was aboard, along with two others, were sent to bombard and destroy [[Tipoca City]], the Kaminoan [[capital]] and largest cloning facility. After the city had been destroyed, [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] asked the clone for a status report, in which the [[trooper]] confirmed that all Kaminoan facilities had collapsed into the ocean. Satisfied, Rampart ordered his ships to rendezvous with the rest of the fleet. ==Personality and traits== As a clone of [[Jango Fett]], the trooper was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. In the wake of the [[Great Jedi Purge]], this clone, just as the overwhelming majority of other clones, went on to serve the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. The trooper had a strong sense of duty, but was audibly dispirited when he informed Rampart of the destruction of Kamino's cloning facilities, likely feeling saddened by the loss of the facility where he had been born. ==Equipment== As a stormtrooper during the early [[Standard year|years]] of the Galactic Empire's reign, this clone wore standard-issue [[Phase II clone trooper armor|Phase 2 clone trooper armor]] that was devoid of any markings or color.{{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Kamino Lost}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი კლონი სამხედრო (VZ-114) }} [[Category:Clone stormtroopers]] [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Males]]
